title: Refuse git reset in an agent's Bash call
why: Incident: a builder ran `git reset --soft` in its own worktree (no change made, but no guard stopped it) (lane writer-lists-awaiting-threads).
source: coordinator 12:57 CST Nov 12 (its clock), from lane writer-lists-awaiting-threads hand-in to runner 10
note: Mistake: an agent runs git reset. Harm: it can drop work in a shared tree (rule shared-trees-no-destructive-git). Fix: refuse `git reset` in an agent's Bash call. Red first on the incident. Coordinator follow-up (undoable), start when ready.
